    WHERE mb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')

    -- Base: components from model BOM

           mc.component_id, mc.component_qty as qty_at_level,

        sm.sku_id,

    WHERE mb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')

        mc.sku_id,

        c.is_assembly
    FROM model_components mc

    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        cp.sku_id,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        cp.total_qty * cb.qty AS total_qty,
        c.is_assembly
    FROM component_paths cp
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cp.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    JOIN component c ON cb.child_component_id = c.component_id

asm_component AS (
    SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'ASM-587-03743'
),
-- Recursively find all assemblies that contain ASM-587-03743 at any level
containing_assemblies AS (
    -- Direct parents of ASM-587-03743 in current BOM
    SELECT cb.parent_component_id AS assembly_id
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN asm_component a ON cb.child_component_id = a.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION
    
    -- Higher level assemblies that contain those assemblies
    SELECT cb.parent_component_id AS assembly_id
    FROM component_bom cb
    JOIN containing_assemblies ca ON cb.child_component_id = ca.assembly_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),
-- All component IDs that are ASM-587-03743 or contain it
all_matching_components AS (
    SELECT component_id AS matching_id FROM asm_component
    UNION
    SELECT assembly_id FROM containing_assemblies
),
-- Find company models that directly use any of these components in current model BOM
matching_models AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mb.model_id
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN all_matching_components amc ON mb.component_id = amc.matching_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM company_model cm
JOIN matching_models mm ON cm.model_id = mm.model_id
ORDER BY cm.model_code"}

part AS (
  SELECT component_id FROM component WHERE component_code = 'MOT-610-BLK-01855'
),

bom_up AS (
  -- Start with the part itself
  SELECT component_id AS child_id, component_id AS parent_id, 1 AS qty, 0 AS level
  FROM part
  UNION ALL
  -- Go up: find parents of current nodes
  SELECT cb.child_component_id, cb.parent_component_id, cb.qty, bu.level + 1
  FROM component_bom cb
  JOIN bom_up bu ON cb.child_component_id = bu.parent_id
  WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- All component IDs that contain the part (including the part itself)

  SELECT DISTINCT parent_id AS component_id FROM bom_up
),
-- Find models that use any of these components (directly in model_bom)
models_with_part AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT mb.model_id
  FROM model_bom mb
  JOIN all_containing_components acc ON mb.component_id = acc.component_id
  WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01' AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Find non-bundle SKUs that map to these models

  SELECT DISTINCT sm.sku_id
  FROM sku_model sm

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "
WITH RECURSIVE
-- Find all SKUs that map directly to model 127
 direct_skus AS (
     SELECT sku_id, qty as model_qty
     FROM sku_model
     WHERE model_id = 127
 ),
 -- Find all item SKUs that map directly to the model
 item_skus_for_model AS (
     SELECT sku_id
     FROM sku_model
     WHERE model_id = 127
 ),
 -- Find bundles that contain these item SKUs
 bundles_with_model AS (
     SELECT bi.bundle_sku_id, bi.item_sku_id, bi.qty as item_qty_in_bundle
     FROM bundle_item bi
     JOIN item_skus_for_model ism ON bi.item_sku_id = ism.sku_id
 ),
 -- For direct SKUs: each order line qty = model units sold
 -- For bundle SKUs: each order line qty * item_qty_in_bundle * model_qty = model units sold
 all_sales AS (
     -- Direct SKUs
     SELECT 
         ol.order_id,
         ol.line_no,
         l.sku_id,
         'direct' as source,
         ol.qty as line_qty,
         sm.qty as model_qty,
         1 as item_qty_in_bundle,
         ol.qty * sm.qty as model_units_sold
     FROM order_line ol
     JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
     JOIN sku_model sm ON l.sku_id = sm.sku_id
     JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
     WHERE sm.model_id = 127
       AND o.status = 'completed'
       AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
     
     UNION ALL
     
     -- Bundle SKUs
     SELECT 
         ol.order_id,
         ol.line_no,
         l.sku_id,
         'bundle' as source,
         ol.qty as line_qty,
         sm.qty as model_qty,
         bi.item_qty_in_bundle,
         ol.qty * bi.item_qty_in_bundle * sm.qty as model_units_sold
     FROM order_line ol
     JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
     JOIN bundles_with_model bi ON l.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
     JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
     JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
     WHERE sm.model_id = 127
       AND o.status = 'completed'
       AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
 )
SELECT SUM(model_units_sold) as total_units_sold
FROM all_sales
"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "
-- Count units sold for model VI4-180GRY78-0078 in completed orders in 2023
-- Including both direct SKUs and SKUs inside bundles
WITH 
-- All SKUs that map directly to model 79
direct_skus AS (
    SELECT s.sku_id
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN sku_model sm ON s.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE sm.model_id = 79
),
-- All bundle SKUs that contain a SKU mapping to model 79
bundle_skus AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.sku_id
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON b.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE b.is_bundle = true AND sm.model_id = 79
),
-- All listings for direct SKUs
direct_listings AS (
    SELECT l.listing_id, l.sku_id, 1 as model_per_unit
    FROM listing l
    WHERE l.sku_id IN (SELECT sku_id FROM direct_skus)
),
-- All listings for bundle SKUs
bundle_listings AS (
    SELECT l.listing_id, l.sku_id, bi.qty as model_per_unit
    FROM listing l
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON l.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE l.sku_id IN (SELECT sku_id FROM bundle_skus)
      AND sm.model_id = 79
),
-- Combine all relevant listings
all_relevant_listings AS (
    SELECT listing_id, model_per_unit FROM direct_listings
    UNION ALL
    SELECT listing_id, model_per_unit FROM bundle_listings
)
SELECT SUM(ol.qty * arl.model_per_unit) as total_units_sold
FROM orders o
JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN all_relevant_listings arl ON ol.listing_id = arl.listing_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
  AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
"}

{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "
WITH RECURSIVE 
-- Find the model_id for VI4-180WAL93-0675
model AS (
    SELECT model_id 
    FROM company_model 
    WHERE model_code = 'VI4-180WAL93-0675'
),
-- Direct SKU mappings to this model
direct_skus AS (
    SELECT s.sku_id, s.sku_code, sm.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN sku_model sm ON s.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    CROSS JOIN model m
    WHERE sm.model_id = m.model_id
),
-- Bundles that contain SKUs mapping to this model
bundle_skus AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.sku_id, s.sku_code
    FROM sales_sku s
    WHERE s.is_bundle = true
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM bundle_item bi
          JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
          CROSS JOIN model m
          WHERE bi.bundle_sku_id = s.sku_id
            AND sm.model_id = m.model_id
      )
),
-- For bundles, we need to find how many of the target model are in each bundle
bundle_model_qty AS (
    SELECT 
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_code,
        SUM(bi.qty * sm.qty) AS total_model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON s.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    CROSS JOIN model m
    WHERE sm.model_id = m.model_id
    GROUP BY s.sku_id, s.sku_code
),
-- All relevant SKUs with their model quantities
all_skus AS (
    SELECT sku_id, sku_code, model_qty AS qty_per_sku, 'direct' AS source
    FROM direct_skus
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sku_id, sku_code, total_model_qty AS qty_per_sku, 'bundle' AS source
    FROM bundle_model_qty
),
-- Get order lines for these SKUs in completed orders in 2025
order_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        a.sku_id,
        a.qty_per_sku,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        a.qty_per_sku * ol.qty AS total_model_units
    FROM all_skus a
    JOIN listing l ON a.sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN order_line ol ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_model_units), 0) AS total_units_sold
FROM order_sales
"}

WITH RECURSIVE 
-- All SKUs that map directly to model 232
direct_skus AS (
    SELECT sku_id, qty as model_qty
    FROM sku_model
    WHERE model_id = 232
),
-- All bundle SKUs and their item SKUs that map to model 232
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id,
        bi.item_sku_id,
        bi.qty as bundle_item_qty,
        sm.qty as model_qty
    FROM bundle_item bi
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE sm.model_id = 232
),
-- Calculate total units from direct SKUs
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(ol.qty * sm.qty) as total
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON l.sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
      AND sm.model_id = 232
),
-- Calculate total units from bundle SKUs
bundle_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(ol.qty * bi.qty * sm.qty) as total
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON l.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON bi.item_sku_id = sm.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
      AND sm.model_id = 232
)
SELECT COALESCE(d.total, 0) + COALESCE(b.total, 0) as total_units
FROM direct_sales d, bundle_sales b

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Get all completed orders for Amazon-JP-13 in 2025
completed_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.store_name = 'Amazon-JP-13'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),

-- Get all order lines with their SKU info
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        sk.sku_id,
        sk.sku_code,
        sk.is_bundle,
        o.order_date
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    JOIN completed_orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
),

-- For bundles, explode to item SKUs; for non-bundles, keep as is
exploded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.line_qty,
        ol.sku_id,
        ol.sku_code,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.line_qty AS sku_qty  -- qty of this SKU in the order
    FROM order_lines ol
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs -> item SKUs
    SELECT 
        ol.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        ol.line_qty,
        bi.item_sku_id AS sku_id,
        sk.sku_code,
        ol.order_date,
        ol.line_qty * bi.qty AS sku_qty  -- bundle qty * item qty per bundle
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON ol.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON bi.item_sku_id = sk.sku_id
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = true
),

-- Map SKUs to models
sku_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.order_id,
        es.line_no,
        es.sku_qty,
        sm.model_id,
        sm.qty AS model_per_sku_qty,
        es.order_date,
        es.sku_qty * sm.qty AS model_qty  -- total model units
    FROM exploded_skus es
    JOIN sku_model sm ON es.sku_id = sm.sku_id
),

-- Get all components from model BOM (including recursive assemblies)
-- First, get direct components from model BOM
model_components AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.line_no,
        sm.model_qty,
        mb.component_id,
        mb.qty AS comp_per_model_qty,
        sm.order_date,
        sm.model_qty * mb.qty AS total_comp_qty
    FROM sku_models sm
    JOIN model_bom mb ON sm.model_id = mb.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= sm.order_date 
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
),

-- Recursively explode assemblies
recursive_components AS (
    -- Base: all components from model BOM
    SELECT 
        mc.order_id,
        mc.line_no,
        mc.component_id,
        mc.total_comp_qty AS qty,
        mc.order_date,
        1 AS level
    FROM model_components mc
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        rc.order_id,
        rc.line_no,
        cb.child_component_id AS component_id,
        rc.qty * cb.qty AS qty,
        rc.order_date,
        rc.level + 1
    FROM recursive_components rc
    JOIN component c ON rc.component_id = c.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb ON rc.component_id = cb.parent_component_id
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
      AND cb.valid_from <= rc.order_date 
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR rc.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)

-- Sum qty for part CAB-394-WHT-01706
SELECT SUM(rc.qty) AS total_units_consumed
FROM recursive_components rc
JOIN component comp ON rc.component_id = comp.component_id
WHERE comp.component_code = 'CAB-394-WHT-01706'
  AND comp.is_assembly = false
"}
